assessment_metadata.evaluator: Senior Financial Data Engineer & Model Risk Validator
assessment_metadata.governance_rule: Claims regarding capabilities, pricing, and coverage must be labeled CONFIRMED or UNVERIFIED_ESTIMATE.

providers.geographic_coverage: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, European Union
providers.sme_eligibility: Requires SME borrower to complete OAuth account-linking consent flow.
providers.historical_depth: Up to 24 months of settled transaction ledger entries.
providers.refresh_frequency: Continuous / Webhook on settlement (1 to 4 syncs daily).
providers.timestamp_guarantees: ISO 8601 transaction posted timestamp and authorized timestamp provided.
providers.reporting_lag_guarantee: Delta T <= 24 hours from bank clearing.
providers.licensing_and_permitted_use: Commercial SaaS agreement. Permitted for underwriting and credit risk monitoring. Re-distribution prohibited.
providers.consent_and_privacy_requirements: Explicit SME authorized officer consent under Dodd-Frank 1033 / GDPR / PSD2. 90-180 day consent re-authorization required in EU/UK.

indicative_cost.estimated_range_usd: $1.50 - $3.50 per connected account / month + API volume fees
indicative_cost.basis: Industry benchmark pricing; formal vendor quote required.

approval_dependencies: Enterprise Vendor Security Review (SOC 2 Type II audit)
Executive Credit Risk Committee Budget Approval
providers.confirmed_capabilities_summary: High API uptime (99.9%), standardized transaction classification, supports thousands of financial institutions.
unverified_assumptions: Ability to obtain historical backfills for firms that subsequently failed
Willingness of distressed SMEs to maintain active OAuth tokens

providers.geographic_coverage: US, UK, EU, Australia, New Zealand
providers.sme_eligibility: SMEs utilizing cloud accounting (QuickBooks, Xero, Sage) or business banking.
providers.historical_depth: Up to 36 months of accounting ledger and bank feeds.
providers.refresh_frequency: Scheduled daily sync or on-demand push.
providers.timestamp_guarantees: Direct ledger entry timestamps from underlying SME accounting software.
providers.reporting_lag_guarantee: Real-time to 24-hour sync lag depending on SME accounting updates.
providers.licensing_and_permitted_use: Enterprise data platform license. Data storage in enterprise cloud permitted.
providers.consent_and_privacy_requirements: Single sign-on SME consent; subject to GDPR and local data protection regulations.

indicative_cost.basis: Enterprise SaaS tier estimate; custom contract negotiation required.

providers.delivery_method: REST API + Webhooks + Direct Cloud Storage Export (Parquet/S3)
providers.minimum_viable_sample_size: 300 SME cohorts with linked accounting ledgers
approval_dependencies: Data Protection Officer (DPO) Privacy Impact Assessment
providers.confirmed_capabilities_summary: Unified data model across multiple ERPs, includes both bank cash-flow and invoice aging.
unverified_assumptions: Consistent bookkeeping hygiene across distressed micro-enterprises

providers.product_name: D&B Commercial Credit Risk / PAYDEX Data Tape
providers.geographic_coverage: Global (over 500 million commercial entities across 200+ countries)
providers.sme_eligibility: All registered commercial enterprises with active trade supplier lines.
providers.historical_depth: Up to 60 months of historical monthly snapshots.
providers.refresh_frequency: Monthly batch tapes; On-demand API queries.
providers.timestamp_guarantees: Monthly reporting cycle cutoff timestamp (T_obs) and publication timestamp (T_pub).
providers.reporting_lag_guarantee: Delta T between 30 and 45 calendar days past statement cycle.
providers.licensing_and_permitted_use: Commercial Credit Bureau Data License. Internal credit modeling permitted. Third-party disclosure prohibited.
providers.consent_and_privacy_requirements: Business entity data (B2B); generally exempt from consumer credit laws (FCRA), but corporate entity licensing terms apply.

indicative_cost.estimated_range_usd: $25,000 - $75,000 / year enterprise subscription based on entity volume
indicative_cost.basis: Commercial bureau tier pricing; formal sales quotation required.

providers.minimum_viable_sample_size: 1,000+ commercial SMEs across diverse industrial sectors
providers.acquisition_owner: Enterprise Risk Management & Credit Bureau Relationship Manager
approval_dependencies: Model Risk Management Data Lineage Approval
providers.confirmed_capabilities_summary: Standardized PAYDEX score (0-100), deep longitudinal trade credit payment experiences.
unverified_assumptions: Sufficient trade reference density for very small or newly established SMEs
Exact mapping of D&B D-U-N-S numbers to anonymized Dataset A entities (Structurally impossible without unmasking)

providers.sme_eligibility: Commercial entities with trade credit and commercial banking relationships.
providers.timestamp_guarantees: Observation date and trade reporting date explicitly recorded.
providers.reporting_lag_guarantee: Delta T approx 30-40 days for trade payment experiences.
providers.licensing_and_permitted_use: Commercial Risk Analytics License. Model development authorized.
providers.consent_and_privacy_requirements: Commercial permissible purpose under business credit evaluation standards.
providers.confirmed_capabilities_summary: Comprehensive DBT metrics, combined business and principal credit risk analytics.

providers.provider_name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
providers.geographic_coverage: United States and major international sovereign economies
providers.sme_eligibility: Public macroeconomic benchmarks; applicable to all commercial risk models.
providers.historical_depth: Over 50 years of historical observations and vintage revisions.
providers.refresh_frequency: Daily / Weekly / Monthly depending on series.
providers.timestamp_guarantees: Exact vintage release dates and historical revision timestamps verified.
providers.reporting_lag_guarantee: Initial release published on official release calendar (Delta T = 0 from official release).
providers.licensing_and_permitted_use: Public Domain / Open Data. Unrestricted commercial and research use.
providers.consent_and_privacy_requirements: None. Aggregate macroeconomic statistics contain zero PII.

indicative_cost.basis: Official public data API provided by Federal Reserve Bank.

providers.confirmed_capabilities_summary: Gold-standard vintage tracking prevents lookahead bias from ex-post revisions.
unverified_assumptions: Direct correlation of US/OECD macro curves with emerging-market SME distress trajectories
